title: DyadMem: A Long-Term Memory Benchmark of How Agents Work with Users
title_zh: DyadMem：智能体如何与用户协作的长期记忆基准
abstract_en: Long-term agents must remember not only what is true about a user, but also how a particular agent should work with that user as their shared history evolves. Existing benchmarks primarily supervise user facts and preferences or experience reusable across users, leaving this relationship-specific agent memory implicit. Additionally, most prior works measure the model solely with final-answer QA over long interaction histories, making the assessment still incomplete and unreliable. To this end, we introduce DyadMem with the proposed new definition User-conditioned Relational Agent Memory (URAM). DyadMem jointly annotates user-side memory and URAM along the same multi-session trajectories, resulting in 6 memory categories. To summarize, it includes 3,065 episodes, 50,961 sessions, and 61,210 QA instances, with extensive session-level Capture and Update gold annotations, query-level Recall support, and two QA settings: Gold-Memory and Full-Pipeline. Across 16 open-weight and 4 proprietary models, Gold-Memory QA is consistently strong, yet Full-Pipeline QA drops sharply. Such a gap explicitly supports our fine-grained evaluation design. Additionally, several quantitative results further reveal low Capture recall, incomplete Recall, and unsafe-deletion issues arising from even the frontier LLMs. We further conduct a rigorous experiment to validate the effectiveness of our URAM and observe the positive effects for all 20 models. In summary, DyadMem is a dual-domain, full-pipeline memory benchmark with extensive annotation efforts for advancing the domain's development.
abstract_zh: 现有长期记忆研究主要关注用户事实、偏好及可跨用户复用的经验，却忽视了特定智能体与用户在长期互动中形成的关系性记忆。论文提出 User-conditioned Relational Agent Memory（URAM）概念，并构建 DyadMem 基准，在多轮、多会话轨迹中联合标注用户侧记忆与 URAM，涵盖 6 类记忆。数据集包含 3,065 个 episodes、50,961 个 sessions 和 61,210 个 QA 实例，并提供会话级 Capture 与 Update 标注、查询级 Recall 支持，以及 Gold-Memory 和 Full-Pipeline 两种评测设置。对 16 个开源模型和 4 个闭源模型的实验显示，Gold-Memory QA 表现普遍较强，但 Full-Pipeline QA 显著下降，暴露出记忆捕获率低、召回不完整和不安全删除等问题。进一步实验表明，URAM 能够提升全部 20 个模型的表现。
key_points_zh: 提出 User-conditioned Relational Agent Memory（URAM），刻画特定智能体与特定用户长期协作中形成的关系性记忆。
构建 DyadMem 双域、全流水线基准，包含 3,065 个 episodes、50,961 个 sessions 和 61,210 个 QA 实例，覆盖 6 类记忆。
设计 Gold-Memory 与 Full-Pipeline 两种评测，区分记忆内容本身与捕获、更新、召回等完整记忆流程的能力。
20 个模型实验显示，Full-Pipeline QA 相比 Gold-Memory QA 大幅下降，前沿模型仍存在低 Capture recall、Recall 不完整及不安全删除问题。
URAM 对全部 20 个模型均带来正向效果，说明关系性记忆是提升长期人机协作的重要因素。

llm_assessment.comment: A highly valuable Agent-memory benchmark that formalizes relationship-specific memory and evaluates capture, update, recall, and deletion across the full lifecycle.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项价值很高的 Agent Memory 基准工作，形式化了关系特定记忆，并覆盖完整生命周期中的捕获、更新、召回与删除评估。
